decisions.reason: Despite some overlap with the firm's biomass-to-nutrients knowledge, this consumer superfood product sits outside its strongest industrial process and engineering learning base, and its absence from the website for two years suggests resources are better redeployed to core technologies.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions remain closely aligned with the firm's core plant, automation and prototyping capabilities, so its in-house R&D and research links give it good scope to absorb feedback and refine the offer even if the line may now be marketed less prominently.

As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant, this product fits the firm's core conversion and engineering knowledge base very strongly, making it more likely to be improved through accumulated know-how and cooperation than withdrawn.
